name: Yet Another Dividing into Teams
justification: Nice realization that the answer is only ever 1 or 2; wordy statement costs a little reading time.
solution_sketch:
Skills are distinct, so the conflict graph is a union of paths and is 2-colourable; one team suffices iff no two skills differ by exactly 1.
Sort and print 2 if some adjacent difference equals 1, else 1.
